independence_rules.mymemory: Mixed/unverified memory and machine output; not an independent vote
independence_rules.libretranslate: Selected server model unverified; no independence assumption

limits: One short probe or a mapping is not a language-wide quality benchmark.
A source and target observation are recorded distinctly.
No universal provider winner is selected from unreviewed strings or engine agreement.
Fresh live execution can fail or vary; no guarantee of a public endpoint’s uptime.

latest_observation.condition: ObservedGoogle quota;198Bing+6MyMemory. Completion is not accuracy.

automatic_preference_1_2_1.basis: User-observed Persian preference plus 24 live Bing domain passages in both directions. Google returned HTTP429 in the current comparison; its semantic quality was not measured.
automatic_preference_1_2_1.limits: A scoped operational preference, not a universal or statistically established quality ranking. Explicit choice wins; disabled providers are never enabled; Dari identity remains separate.
